claims.originating_goal: Independently verify the public served MyKV install shell, manifest, and Node-continuity loader before exposing the single current-iPhone owner installation action.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after observer source validates, merges, and an exact-main public MyKV served-body proof artifact is inspected and canonically reconciled.
expected_evidence: public install shell HTTP 200 with current unified MyKV markers
public manifest HTTP 200 with standalone start URL
public Node-continuity loader HTTP 200 with automatic StegOS/Node bootstrap chain
collision_boundaries: Observation only; do not mutate MyKV runtime, Node identity, KV identity, storage host, provider state, or Interlock/InTr state in this lane
Do not expose owner install action from source or CI evidence alone
GitHub Actions may transport evidence only and must not write back runtime state
